description: Sacrifice your own life force to fuel devastating attacks. High risk, high reward. Rewards Strength, Fortitude, and Willpower investment.

skills.name: Etch Blood Rune
skills.description: Sacrifice your own blood to etch a powerful rune. Blood Runes detonate for combined Strength and Willpower modifier damage each.
skills.ai_instruction: Deduct 3 HP from actor (no attack roll, self inflicted). Apply one Blood Rune status to actor. Duration 10 rounds, persists false. Each Blood Rune detonates on next physical hit dealing +(Strength modifier + Willpower modifier) magic damage. All Blood Runes detonate simultaneously and are consumed on hit. Call apply_damage on actor for 3 HP cost, then call apply_status with effect='blood_rune', duration=10, persists=false.

skills.name: Hemorrhage
skills.description: A vicious strike that causes deep bleeding wounds.
skills.ai_instruction: Make physical attack roll (1d20 + Strength modifier) vs target AC. On hit deal weapon dice + Strength modifier damage. Apply Bleeding to target — deals 1d4 + Strength modifier damage each round. Persists true (survives end of combat until cured). Call apply_damage for hit damage then apply_status with effect='bleeding', duration=99, persists=true. On crit: max weapon die + roll + modifier, and Bleeding initial application deals max 1d4 + Strength modifier immediately.

skills.name: Crimson Surge
skills.description: Sacrifice half your current HP to empower your next attack this turn to deal double damage.
skills.ai_instruction: Calculate half of actor's current HP (round down, minimum 1). Deduct that amount from actor HP via apply_damage on self. Apply Crimson Surge status to actor (duration 1, persists false). Next attack this turn deals double damage — roll normally then double the full damage result before calling apply_damage on target. Consume Crimson Surge after the empowered attack.
